acip: RTAGS GNYIS PA MA GRUB NA, RTAG PA DANG GCIG CHOS CAN, KVA BUM GNYIS DANG MI 'GAL BA DANG 'GAL BA YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD KVA BUM GNYIS DANG MI 'GAL BA DANG THA DAD, KHYOD YANG YIN, KVA BUM GNYIS DANG MI 'GAL BA YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA MED PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: rtags gnyis pa ma grub na, rtag pa dang gcig chos can, kva bum gnyis dang mi 'gal ba dang 'gal ba yin par thal, khyod kva bum gnyis dang mi 'gal ba dang tha dad, khyod yang yin, kva bum gnyis dang mi 'gal ba yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa med pa'i phyir
english: Well then, I disagree with the second part of your reason above: it is not the case that something which is the same as unchanging things is contradictory to what is not contradictory to the pair of a coffee table and a coffee cup. Suppose you do disagree. Let's consider then something which is the same as unchanging things. It is so contradictory to what is not contradictory to the pair of a coffee table and a coffee cup, Because (1) it is separate from that which is not contradictory to the pair of a coffee table and a coffee cup; and (2) there is no example of a thing which is both it, and yet not contradictory to the pair of a coffee table and a coffee cup.
